independent_execution.full_report_regeneration: The approved comparator was independently rerun to a temporary output. The regenerated JSON was text-exact and SHA-256-exact to the saved report.
independent_execution.independent_numeric_reconstruction: A separate temporary review script loaded every immutable NPZ directly, verified identical row fields, recomputed eligible-day pinball metrics, formed all six row-level equal-weight ensembles with quantile rearrangement, reconstructed every per-day paired difference and reran every 48-hour 2,000-draw bootstrap interval.

findings.finding: The saved report is a deterministic, exact reconstruction of all 34 reviewed forecast artifacts plus the six predeclared equal-weight ensembles on one identical 1,219-row validation cohort.
The report preserves neutral status and performs no model selection. Controls remain present and labelled diagnostic; core, hybrid and post-hoc provenance remain distinguishable.

The lowest core JEPA family, the core EMA ensemble, is 0.486% worse than the matched direct ensemble on validation. Its paired interval crosses zero, so this validation comparison provides no evidence of incremental JEPA value.

The post-hoc LightGBM score is only 0.094% lower than direct and its paired interval crosses zero. This is a negligible exploratory validation difference and does not establish SOTA or external generalization.

Every comparison is development validation evidence subject to selection-induced optimism. The source clock timezone remains unknown, and no CAL or retrospective TEST acoustic outcome was accessed in this review.

decision_boundary: This review approves the exact neutral comparison artifact only; it does not itself select or promote a model.
Any selection record must apply the separately reviewed ADR 0010 rule without reopening or filtering the candidate set.
Any later CAL or TEST execution must bind the exact selected model artifacts, reader, QC, scoring code, metadata candidate universe and independent pre-access approvals.
